classifications.rationale: The President immediately terminates a prior delegation to the OMB Director as of October 9, 1977; this is an internal reassignment of executive functions rather than a change in legal rights.
classifications.evidence: The delegation to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget

classifications.rationale: The President amends an earlier order to replace the Budget Director and Bureau with the Commerce Secretary and Department, immediately reorganizing internal responsibility.
The President makes the Secretary's performance subordinate to OMB authority and reassigns functions from the Budget Director to the Commerce Secretary; these are internal authority arrangements.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to any authority or responsibility vested in the Director of the Office of Management and Budget

classifications.rationale: The President immediately defines the relationship between the Secretary's assigned functions and the OMB Director's existing authority, an internal management limitation.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to any authority or responsibility vested in the 'Director of the Office of Management and Budget

classifications.rationale: The President amends a prior executive order as part of an internal reassignment of governmental functions; the operative substitution is completed by the adjoining supplied segments.
classifications.evidence: Section 4 of Executive Order No. 11961 of January 19, 1977, is amended

classifications.rationale: The President deletes a prior internal assignment requiring the Council to make congressional reports, with the replacement assignment supplied in the next segment.
classifications.evidence: the Council on International Economic Policy shall perform the function of making periodic reports

classifications.rationale: The President assigns specified statutory functions to the Commerce Secretary through an amendment, an internal allocation of executive responsibility.
classifications.evidence: the Secretary of Commerce shall perform the functions

classifications.rationale: The President presently transfers records, property, personnel, and appropriated balances between executive officials to support the internal transfer of functions.
classifications.evidence: are hereby transferred to the Secretary of Commerce

classifications.rationale: The President directs the OMB Director to take necessary or appropriate implementation steps to carry out the internal transfers, without dictating an external legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: shall make such determinations, issue such orders, and take all steps necessary or appropriate

classifications.rationale: The President requires the Commerce Secretary to advise the OMB Director during internal budget review and preparation.
classifications.evidence: shall provide advice to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget

classifications.rationale: The President establishes and staffs an advisory committee, prescribes internal support and coordination duties, preserves existing administrative actions during the reassignment, and sets the order's effective date; these are inseparable components of internal executive organization and continuity.
classifications.evidence: There is hereby established the Statistical Policy Coordination Committee
